gloss: to be sufficient, to be worthy of

definitions.gloss: to be sufficient, to be enough
definitions.explanation: To meet the requirements or standards needed.

definitions.gloss: to be worthy of, to deserve
definitions.explanation: To have the qualities needed to be considered something.

notes:
{足|た}る is a classical/literary form meaning 'to be sufficient' or 'to be worthy of.' In modern Japanese, the ichidan verb ⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧ is more commonly used for the meaning 'to be enough.'

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)
- Pattern: Xに{足|た}る (worthy of X)

MODERN USAGE:
{足|た}る is mainly used in formal/literary expressions, especially in the pattern 「～に{足|た}る」(worthy of ~).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ～に{足|た}る (worthy of ~, deserving of ~)
- ⟦{信頼|しんらい}→信頼：03268_shinrai⟧に{足|た}る (worthy of trust)
- ⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧に{足|た}る (worthy of attention)
- ⟦{言及|げんきゅう}→言及：10894_genkyuu⟧に{足|た}る (worth mentioning)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {足|た}る: Classical/literary, used in 「～に{足|た}る」
- ⟦{足|た}りる→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: Modern, used for 'to be enough'
